standard_prerequisites.name: Finite partial-order chain/antichain theorem and elementary base-N dominance
standard_prerequisites.use: The author supplies the entire multidimensional extremal construction; only ordinary finite-order theory and dominance of a leading digit are standard tools.

core_obligations: Construct a real point set with independently prescribed upper bounds for all sign-monotone chains using highest differing base-N digits.
Convert it into a partite ordered matching preserving each sign pattern bound.
Prove that a pattern-clique in an abstract blow-up has at most the product of its outer and inner clique bounds.

Follow an arbitrary maximal refinement chain: remove the unique double part at the penultimate level, apply induction at uniformityr-1, double the corresponding coordinate and blow up by the partite construction.
Track both the exact edge count and the exclusion of every pattern outside the selected refinement-chain families.

proof_roadmap.step: Use sign-coded base-N coordinates to force the last differing digit of every monotone chain to have its prescribed sign type.
Establish multiplicative clique control in blow-ups and translate extremal points into partite matchings.
Delete one member of the unique double part, transfer all pattern parameters through an explicit bijection, and lift the inductive matching by doubling.
Combine the disjoint pattern families by blow-up, multiplying cardinalities without multiplying any target pattern bound twice.

difficulty_reason: The construction must simultaneously control independently chosen bounds for many mutually incompatible order patterns. It combines a sign-coded extremal point set with a recursive pattern-family decomposition: coordinate doubling preserves the earlier chain families while the partite blow-up contributes exactly the final family. The crucial obligation is preserving all pair types and proving every excluded type stays absent, not merely multiplying sizes or applying an Erdős-Szekeres bound.

compared.difference: The public item is an upper-bound induction for arbitrary matchings. This target explicitly constructs a matching of product size with prescribed independent pattern-clique caps and no other pair types.

compared.source_reference: Anastos-Jin-Kwan-Sudakov, Extremal, enumerative and probabilistic results on ordered hypergraph matchings, Section4
compared.difference: The author says the new construction generalizes that earlier argument to multiple parameters. Compare exact hypotheses and parameter families before counting as new.

dedup.scope: Same-source public primary and cited closest construction identified; broader semantic/excluded-claim comparison remains root-owned.

review_checkpoints: Sign vectors for distinct coordinates are distinct, and all base-N digits are positive and bounded; sufficient leading-digit separation makes all point coordinates distinct.
A tau_k chain can differ last only at digitk: coordinate1 fixes the sign, then all remaining signs force tau_k=tau_kprime. Hence the chain has at most m_tau_k elements.
The coordinate doubled at the last refinement is in the same interval part at every earlier refinement, so deleting it induces the claimed bijections of pattern families.

Earlier pattern families and the fully partite family are disjoint. In the product clique bound one factor is1 for each admissible target pattern, which prevents unwanted multiplication of its prescribed cap.

For r=2, H={{0,1},{2,3}}, H_r={{0,50},{49,99}}, cuts(-0.5,49.5,99.5), N=51 meets bothwidth inequalities yet reorders copies: an upper coordinate150 from the first outer edge exceeds a lower coordinate102 from the second. Determine whether selecting N sufficiently large in the ordinary sense already authorized by499 is a unique implementation clarification or requires a stronger source correction; do not certify arbitraryN from the weak inequalities.
Neighboring explicit definitions identify the intended negative sign and intermediate H-star; preserve source and assess the precise interpretation.
Independently assess the whole simultaneous multiparameter construction rather than the short final induction alone.

editorial_scope: One strong lower-bound construction along an arbitrary ordered-partition refinement chain. The multidimensional extremal point-set construction and partite/blow-up lemmas are full solution obligations. Earlier upper bounds are neither free assumptions nor additional counted claims.
